title: Add a database migration
summary: Adds one numbered, repeatable schema change and a test that it applies once.
goal: Add a database migration that {change}. Number it after the last existing migration, make it safe to run twice, and keep existing data. Add a test in {test_dir}/ that applies all migrations to an empty database and checks the new column or table.

params.name: change
params.label: The schema change
params.default: adds a nullable created_at column to the main table
